round: V31: five-cell residuals for stage 1 (1536 -> 3072) and stage 3 (6144 -> 12288) on top of V30
status: frozen before any pool generation, training or outcome of this round

base.name: W30 = V30 P-final (website V23 tables with the V30 stage-2 table and residual)

residual: as V29/V30: four five-cell patterns x 8 symmetries per stage, zero initialised, trained jointly with that stage's four-cell table (training/v31-stages/model5s.h)

training.tool: training/v31-stages/train.cpp (V30 parallel trainer generalised to any stage)
training.boundaries: stage 1: an afterstate with 3072 closes the episode with the W30 stage-2 value including its residual; stage 3: 12288 is terminal (value 0)
training.nondeterminism: lock-free updates; hashes recorded after training and before evaluation

S3.poolNote: V27 on-policy 6144-phase starts from CUR play; in stage 3 W30 plays exactly as CUR (every afterstate is stage 3), so they are on-policy for W30

checkpointNote: checkpoints are saved for later study; only final models are evaluated in V31
poolRules: website search with W30 (depth 5, cutoff 0.01, clamp) from standard openings to the first 1536; terminal states excluded; eval1 sorted by seed and cut to 1024

stage1Training.onpolicy: each train1 first-1536 state continued with the W30 website search to 3072 or death; state recorded every 25 moves from move 0 while alive with max card exactly 1536

W31: W30 stage 0 and stage 2 tables and stage-2 residual + S1 stage-1 table and residual + S3 stage-3 table and residual (training/v31-stages/run.py compose; other stages verified byte-identical)

games.search: website default: depth 5, cutoff 0.01, clamp, complete depth every move, standard openings to 12288 or death (training/v31-stages/game.cpp)
games.multiplicity: Holm across P1-P3; no interim analysis

c3.v27Reproduction: W30 here must reproduce V27 confirm-CUR field for field (descriptive determinism check)

conditionalAnalysis: secondary: exact McNemar per conditional pool, Holm across c1 and c3; scoreGained paired differences; Wilson intervals
compile: c++ -std=c++17 -O3 training/v31-stages/{tools,game}.cpp -o training/v31-stages/bin/{tools,game}; c++ -std=c++17 -O3 -pthread training/v31-stages/train.cpp -o training/v31-stages/bin/train
parity: before freezing, with W30 the V31 game and cont tools reproduced V30 games-W (2 games) and select P-final (4 states) field for field, and the V31 trainer with one thread and only a stage-2 residual produced the same model and residual hashes as the V30 trainer (2e6 moves)
